programmes.d: Lucy and Martin visit a derelict chapel in Rastrick, West Yorkshire, a splendid Georgian semi in Derby city centre and a mid terrace investment opportunity near the Thames barrier in London.
Martin & Lucy visit a house in Bishop Auckland, County Durham, a small cottage in Hythe, Kent and a plot of land in Chippenham, Wiltshire.
Martin & Lucy visit a former pub in Salisbury, a mid-terrace in Kent and a house in Derby.
Martin & Lucy visit a Victorian villa in Derby, a flat in South West London and a 2 bed apartment in Sunderland.
Martin and Lucy visit a mid terrace in Devon, a house of two halves in Swindon and a lot of flat for very little cash in Sleby Yorkshire.
Martin and Lucy visit a farm house in Cheshire with space galore, in Margate there's a Georgian town house with hidden treasures and in Derbyshire there's a newly refurbished semi.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander visit a family home in Dorset, a one-bedroom flat in Canterbury and a terrace in Derby.

Martin and Lucy visit a chapel in Nottinghamshire where all the pews are gone but there is one survivor, a semi in Swindon that hasn't been touched in years and building on this Woodland in Leeds could prove a challenge.

Sparks might fly at this beach side bungalow in Cornwall, Lucy finds there's somewhere just right for wannabe grease monkeys in Kent, and in Cardiff Martin visits a three-bedroom house, but can new owners raise this Phoenix from the ashes?

Martin and Lucy discover that there may be tears before bedtime at a build in Devon, a barn behind a Kent bookshop – but the roof's caved in and it's very dangerous, and Martin may have found a way to get rich quick at a bungalow in Stoke.

Martin and Lucy visit a property in Derbyshire where DIY means Damage It Yourself, in South West London there's trouble with this Battersea property and in Cornwall there's a large house that could turn you on.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts travel to Wales to see a 3 bedroom house stuck in the 60's; then on to Wickham to see a 3 bedroom semi with room for improvement. Finally a double fronted terrace; in Derby, but does he want it?
Martin & Lucy visit a two bed house in Lincolnshire, a commercial unit in Dartford, Kent and a standard semi in Cornwall.

Lucy Alexander and Martin Roberts visit mid terrace property in Blackpool, a property in Earlsfield in London which requires very little work & an old cottage in Harrogate which is in need of updating.
Martin & Lucy visit a property in Cornwall, a bungalow in Nottinghamshire and a mid terraced house in Kent.
Martin & Lucy visit a bungalow in Devon, a property in London and a house with potential in Salford.
Lucy and Martin visit a gorgeous 19th Century Church which is up for sale, a plot of land in Middlesex with planning permission for two one-bedroom flats and a studio flat in the heart of London.
Martin and Lucy visit a bungalow in Nottingham, a flat in London and a delightful cottage in Devon.
Martin and Lucy view properties in Berkshire, Scunthorpe and West Sussex.
Martin Roberts and Lucy Alexander view properties in St. Germans, Isle of Wight and New Brighton.
Martin and Lucy visit a detached property in Cheadle, revisit a house in London a year after we first saw it and a flat in Truro.
